bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Playoff-bound Gwangju's surging attack tests already-safe Bucheon's leaky road defense.

spf.comment: Covers both a 2:1 Gwangju win powered by Ba Loua and Iredale and a 1:1 stalemate, as Gwangju's 11.8% home clean-sheet rate and 14 season draws make a single result call riskier.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.70 total lambda, combined 3.76 xGA per game, and 7 of the two clubs' combined last 10 league outings producing three or more goals.

btts.comment: Both defenses struggle for shutouts (11.8% Gwangju home clean sheets, 11 goals conceded by Bucheon in 5 games) against active frontlines, aligning with a 54.2% Poisson BTTS anchor.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Gwangju's recent offensive superiority paired with their persistent home goal concessions, while 1:1 captures the modal Poisson outcome and Gwangju's back-to-back recent draws.

goals.comment: Three goals fits the 2.70 total lambda and recent multi-goal trend, with two goals covering the 24.5% modal Poisson count if finishing wastefulness slows the second half.

bqc.comment: Gwangju has drawn 70.6% of home first halves without a single half-time lead in 17 home games, making a level interval before a second-half home winner or shared 1:1 draw the primary splits.
